segments.name: Private aviation services
segments.description: Owner and operator of private jets providing charter flights through a jet club, fractional ownership, and MRO services to private aviation customers.
segments.evidence: we operate under one reportable segment, which is private aviation services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay non-refundable membership deposits, daily and hourly flight rates, fractional ownership purchase deposits, and MRO billing based on parts and labor.
revenueModel.evidence: Jet club revenue is generated from flight operations as well as membership fees.

changes.text: In 2023, the company completed its business combination through the merger of LGM Enterprises, LLC.
changes.evidence: the December 27, 2023 merger of LGM Enterprises, LLC, a North Carolina limited liability company ("LGM"), pursuant to an Equity Purchase Agreement, dated as of October 17, 2022

changes.text: In 2024, the company entered into an aircraft management services agreement with Volato Group, Inc.
changes.evidence: On September 2, 2024, the Company entered into an Aircraft Management Services Agreement (the "Volato Agreement") with Volato Group, Inc.

changes.text: In 2025, the company amended the Volato Agreement to add asset purchase options.
changes.evidence: On October 1, 2025, the Company and Volato entered into the Amendment to the Volato Agreement.
